adapter_coverage.count_semantics: Source editions are counted separately; matching native locus keys are not independent manuscript samples or verified physical lines. Exclusion reasons may overlap.

limitations: exposed-data description; no inferential test or untouched evaluation
same native key is not verified image-region or physical-line equivalence
ASCII chain agreement is not glyph, language, phonetic-word, or source-accuracy agreement
drawing interruption separators are not necessarily manuscript word spaces
eligibility depends on both editions; excluded loci may systematically differ

processing.boundary_unit: cumulative ASCII-letter offset in an identical concatenated chain
processing.cohort_rule: eligible in both editions under both comma policies; at least one token
processing.locator_rule: all present P0 locators; differing locators retained explicitly
